item.title: Air Supply, Air Quality, and X45 Consumables
item.description: Air pressure, flow, and dryness for the CUT45, plus X45 machine-torch consumable part numbers, inspection, and the order to reassemble them.

item.title: CUT45 (X45 Torch) Cut Settings
item.description: Starting cut settings for the CUT45 with the X45 machine torch: the Razorweld-supplied chart, a T45m-format chart reportedly from Jasic, the manual’s table, forum numbers, and how to dial them in.

item.title: Getting Rid of Dross and Bevel
item.description: Fixing dross and bevel on a CrossFire PRO with the CUT45 and X45 torch, in order from cheapest and most likely: consumables, air, torch square, height, speed, amps, cut direction, material.

item.title: Test-Cut Program: Checking the Starting Settings, Coupon by Coupon
item.description: A planned, coupon-by-coupon test program for checking the Razorweld-supplied chart (and the T45m-format chart’s voltages) on a CrossFire PRO with the CUT45 and X45 torch, with every cut logged.
